mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (date, time, product_name, code_number, specification, type, in_quantity, out_quantity, receiver) VALUES (#{r.date}, #{r.time}, #{r.productName}, #{r.codeNumber}, #{r.specification}, #{r.type}, #{r.inQuantity}, #{r.outQuantity}, #{r.receiver})
mapper.select: SELECT specification, price, type FROM ${table} WHERE product_name = #{productName} AND (receiver IS NULL OR receiver NOT IN ('Mobile','mobile')) AND price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT product_code, specification, price, category AS type FROM stock_data WHERE product_name = #{productName} LIMIT 1
SELECT category FROM stock_data WHERE product_name = #{productName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (date, time, code_number, product_name, in_quantity, out_quantity, specification, price, receiver, remark, target_system, type, mobile_ref_id) VALUES (#{r.date}, #{r.time}, #{r.codeNumber}, #{r.productName}, #{r.inQuantity}, #{r.outQuantity}, #{r.specification}, #{r.price}, 'Mobile', NULL, #{r.targetSystem}, #{r.type}, #{r.mobileRefId})
INSERT INTO ${table} (product_name, code_number, specification, total_qty) VALUES (#{productName}, #{codeNumber}, #{specification}, #{qty})
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, (SELECT s.category FROM stock_data s WHERE s.product_name = t.product_name LIMIT 1) AS type FROM ${table} t ORDER BY t.product_name ASC
